serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Mrs. Fisher: Sorry, no can do. 
You: Why?!
Mrs. Fisher: You remember everything, right? You know the deal. It’s too dangerous now. 
You: I don’t care! Just one more time! That's all I’m asking for!
You: Where’s the joint? I know you have it?!
Mrs. Fisher: S-Stop, kid. I won’t give it to you. Get your hands off me! 
You: In which pocket do you have it?! 
#mrsfisher.Face.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: I SAID STOP YOU LITTLE WORM! {{punch}}
You: Ouch…
As I was going through Mrs. Fisher’s pockets one by one, she right‑hooked me square in the nose…
Mrs. Fisher: Did that help you to calm down?
You: Yes… {{wi}}Sorry…
You: I don’t know what got into me, sorry for attacking you like that…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.NormalClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Don’t worry, kid. You weren’t yourself. 
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: I don’t know what you saw in there, but these visions are only inside your head, they ain’t real.
You: …
Mrs. Fisher: Go home now and try to relax. Also, clean up that nose bleed.
You: Oh, shit. You are right. I’m bleeding quite a bit…
It will be a pain to explain this to {f_botName}...
You: Sorry Mrs. Fisher for wasting your time on me.
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Don’t mention it.
